files.credit_line: "Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum" by Quintin Soloviev, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: High oblique drone view from above the peristyle (west end) looking east down the length of the empty bowl, August 2025, football configuration with goalposts and yard lines. Field centred horizontally (x ~970-1460) and in rows ~640-1120 of 1680; a 16:9 crop of rows ~330-1680 puts the field at ~23-58% with the peristyle arch and Olympic torch below it. A beige protective covering sits on the near end zone. Converted from the Commons PNG to JPEG (quality 88). Overcast light.
